description: Security teams face a constant stream of vulnerabilities and alerts. He sees automation from companies like OpenAI as a way to take on routine security work and help teams keep pace.
title: AI for Detection and Response | Cloudflare’s Mark Anderson

description: How can AI help reduce the demands of IPO preparation? title: Moving IPO Work Forward with AI | Cooley + OpenAI

author: OpenAI
description:
“It is a prerequisite for staying safe that you must use AI.”

Attackers can move at machine speed. Defenders need security controls that can adapt just as quickly.

Jeetu Patel, President of Cisco, explains why OpenAI is becoming a core foundation for that work. With capabilities like Daybreak and Astra, Cisco sees an opportunity to make security controls and policies dynamic—and strengthen defenses for the businesses that depend on them.

Watch why Cisco is rethinking how defense gets done.
title: Why Cybersecurity Needs AI | Cisco’s Jeetu Patel
